Address an opponent face to face with a deliberate threatening promise: controlled anger on the first words, gathering force toward the final phrase. A physically grounded, proud and confident character performance. Natural human articulation, dry close studio recording, one speaker, conversational speaking speed.

Threat and attack cry sound like one character; Russian pronunciation is credible by listening.
ASR reproduces the required words; no inserted spoken tag, clipping, cut syllable or unexplained silence.
The complete voice fits the acting and action timing naturally. Change animation timing if appropriate instead of stretching the voice to force an old window.
Only after the audition passes, replace both old voice events, rebuild the envelopes and mix; preserve other event sources.
